description: Has it been recalled in the US? One call across the federal recall sources: CPSC consumer products (hazard, remedy, units, where sold), FDA food, drug and device enforcement reports (class I-III with meaning, reason, status, distribution) and NHTSA vehicle campaigns for a make, model and year or a VIN (component, consequence, remedy, park-it warnings). Search a product, brand, ingredient or firm; counts per source plus the newest recalls. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

category.description: all (default) or any of consumer, food, drug, device
